items.exampleEn: Cats belong to the same family as tigers.
Please organize your books by color.
items.exampleZh: 請把你的書依顏色整理好。

items.exampleEn: In the movie, beings from another planet visit us.
items.exampleZh: 電影裡，來自另一個星球的生物來拜訪我們。

items.exampleEn: The teacher marked my test in red.
items.exampleZh: 老師用紅筆批改我的考卷。

items.exampleEn: Don't mix red and green paint.
items.exampleZh: 不要把紅色和綠色的顏料混在一起。

items.exampleEn: He left his job to pursue music.
items.exampleZh: 他辭掉工作去追求音樂。

items.exampleEn: She always blames her little brother.
She wears a silver chain around her neck.
items.exampleZh: 她脖子上戴著一條銀鍊子。

items.sentenceEn: Don't blame me. It wasn't my fault.

items.audioEn: Who does this bag belong to? It was on the bus.
items.audioZh: 這個包包是誰的？它被放在公車上。
items.questionZh: 這個包包是在哪裡發現的？

items.sentenceEn: My mom mixed the eggs and the flour in a bowl.
items.sentenceZh: 媽媽把蛋和麵粉放在碗裡攪拌。

items.stemEn: My sister ____ a surprise party for Mom's birthday.
items.stemZh: 我姊姊為媽媽的生日籌辦了一場驚喜派對。

items.stemEn: My bike ____ came off, so I had to walk home.
items.stemZh: 我腳踏車的鏈條掉了，所以只好走路回家。

items.passageEn: My cousin Mia wants to pursue her dream of becoming a chef. Last month, she organized a cooking class for kids in our town. She showed them how to mix flour and water to make bread. One boy got a white mark on his face, and everyone laughed. At the end, Mia gave each child a small chain with a little gold spoon. "Cooking belongs to everyone," she said.
items.passageZh: 我表姊 Mia 想追求當廚師的夢想。上個月，她為鎮上的孩子們籌辦了一堂烹飪課。她教大家怎麼把麵粉和水混合做成麵包。有個男孩臉上沾了一塊白白的痕跡，大家都笑了。最後，Mia 送給每個孩子一條掛著小金湯匙的鍊子。她說：「烹飪是屬於每個人的。」

questions.questionZh: Mia 送給每個孩子什麼？
options: 一本寫滿 Mia 食譜的小筆記本
一條掛著小金湯匙的鍊子

referenceEn: These keys belong to my brother.
These keys belong to my older brother.
rubricZh: 「是…的」可寫，例如 belong to my brother、are my brother's 等
主詞複數時動詞不加 s（例如 These keys belong）

items.instructionZh: 用 pursue 造一個句子，說說你或別人想追求的夢想或目標。
referenceEn: I want to pursue my dream of becoming a singer.
My sister is pursuing her interest in art.
rubricZh: pursue 後面接夢想或目標（例如 pursue a dream、pursue her interest）
可寫例如 want to pursue、is pursuing
